paper_metadata.title: GIT: A Generative Image-to-text Transformer for Vision and Language
paper_metadata.abstract: In this paper, we design and train a Generative Image-to-text Transformer, GIT, to unify vision-language tasks such as image/video captioning and question answering. While generative models provide a consistent network architecture between pre-training and fine-tuning, existing work typically contains complex structures (uni/multi-modal encoder/decoder) and depends on external modules such as object detectors/taggers and optical character recognition (OCR). In GIT, we simplify the architecture as one image encoder and one text decoder under a single language modeling task. We also scale up the pre-training data and the model size to boost the model performance. Without bells and whistles, our GIT establishes new state of the arts on 12 challenging benchmarks with a large margin. For instance, our model surpasses the human performance for the first time on TextCaps (138.2 vs. 125.5 in CIDEr). Furthermore, we present a new scheme of generation-based image classification and scene text recognition, achieving decent performance on standard benchmarks. Codes are released at \url{https://github.com/microsoft/GenerativeImage2Text}.

extraction_data.innovation: Generative image-to-text transformer combining a contrastive vision encoder with a decoder-only language model trained via causal language modeling on image-text pairs; enables free-form answer generation for VQA without predefined candidate answers; extends to video captioning via learnable temporal embeddings and to image classification via autoregressive prediction of class names.

extraction_data.finetuning_task: Image captioning, visual question answering, video captioning, image classification, Image/video captioning, Task-specific fine-tuning for captioning, VQA
extraction_data.research_problem: Vision and language understanding, image captioning
extraction_data.application: Image captioning, video captioning, visual question answering, image classification, scene text recognition

extraction_data.innovation: Generative image-to-text transformer unifying vision and language tasks; vocabulary-constrained decoding via a trie structure to guarantee in-vocabulary output; lightweight fine-tuning for few-shot learning that updates parameters once and removes support shots during inference, reducing cost compared to methods like Flamingo.
